notes.title: Collectibles Update - Full Version of Car Dealer Simulator
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Dealers![/h2]

If you’ve already played the prologue Car Dealer Simulator Prologue - Early Days, it’s time to check out the full game. Today, we’ve added a new update to the full version of Car Dealer Simulator.

[h3]What’s new?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]New junkyard station - car crusher[/b]
Prepare a car that’s 100% mechanically functional. It must be also rust-free, washed, and polished. Once it meets all requirements, you can crush it into a trophy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/7101297d74e995519199455b2e4ac4fccaecf3e6.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Trophies with multiple tiers[/b]
Trophies are divided into: common, silver, gold, and diamond. Each higher tier requires crafting a certain number of figurines. You can find the details at the crusher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/1f0631fce89d6e280a29264bc742acb53101c50a.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Trophy shelf[/b]
Show off your crafted trophies in the office and impress your clients with your collection. Shelves are available in level 3 and 4 offices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/bb6f17b9db95bf55c6345883bdfe580df4a3df86.gif[/img]
 
[*] [b]New vehicle info app[/b]
A full vehicle encyclopedia has been added – you’ll find descriptions of every car, fun facts, and the new statistics feature. From now on, you can track things like: number of cars bought, kilometers driven, fuel consumed, and more. Stats are tracked starting from this patch, so your achievements begin now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/5aa9e04852d0a916bd141a9a4779c3282e5cf4af.png[/img]

[/list]

Enjoy the new possibilities and show off your trophies to your clients!

[b]And next week… can you guess what’s coming?
Yes, a brand-new sports car is speeding your way! 🚗💨[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/KVMHmsZNs6]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img]
[/url]

In the meantime, we invite you to check out the forum thread where we gather your feedback and ideas for future updates:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2404880/discussions/0/604157805816993720/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/8eecb0ebf0b126bee92555de2196bb23b533c542.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator

notes.title: Full Version of Car Dealer Simulator Released on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Dealers![/h2]

[h3]Today is a big day for us! After nearly two years of development, the full version of [b]Car Dealer Simulator is now available on Steam[/b]![/h3]

We want to [b]thank you all[/b] for the warm reception of the prologue and the demo, for your amazing feedback in reviews, countless ideas, and your continuous support on Discord! We hope this release is just the beginning and that we’ll be able to keep developing what we’ve built together.

[h3]Here we go![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/7b872a9aa9ae0d8be987c496871f4f04bcbdc770.gif[/img]

Special thanks go out to all the [b]Content Creators[/b] who made videos and streams about Car Dealer Simulator. This is our first full game, and we wouldn’t have reached so many players without you. No matter how many subscribers you have - we’re incredibly grateful!

In the meantime, [b]we wish you a great time playing[/b] and look forward to [b]your reviews[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img]

notes.title: 30 Days to Release + Workshop Level 2 Features!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Dealers![/h2]

[h3]Only [b]30 days left[/b] until the full release of [i]Car Dealer Simulator[/i]! 🚗💥[/h3]
The launch is happening on [b]May 29, 2025, at 7:00 PM CEST[/b] on [b]Steam[/b]! Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist so you don’t miss the notification!
🔥 [i]We’re beyond excited to finally deliver the full version into your hands - packed with new features, challenges, and ways to grow your very own car business![/i]

While you wait for the big day, here’s another batch of exciting updates - including new stages of progression for your company!

[h3]🔧 Workshop Level 2 - time to step up your game![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/e425e023f10a6f49f647c8c65357860f4bd29863.gif[/img]

Level 2 of the workshop isn’t just a visual upgrade - though we must say, it’s starting to look [b]seriously professional[/b]. A [b]car lift[/b] becomes available, unlocking a whole new set of mechanical repair options!

🔹 [b]Level 1[/b] allows for basic tasks such as:
- Patching exhaust holes with tape,
- Replacing fuses,
- Swapping out the car battery.

🔹 [b]Level 2[/b] raises the bar! Now you can:
- Replace brake discs and calipers,
- Professionally install full exhaust parts instead of just patching things up,
- Work on shock absorbers and other suspension components.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/55bf628963cb7151809ec4f114bfe86b1a5a9ca9.png[/img]

And that’s just the beginning - more levels and features are on the way!

Got questions? Want to see a specific feature covered in the next devlog? Let us know in the comments or on Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/KVMHmsZNs6][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/dfeb02699a90ea80d8d814bced9904b42dc42bc7.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello Car Dealers!

In today’s update, we’re bringing a change that many of you have been eagerly waiting for. One of the main pieces of feedback we’ve received, which represented the majority of the negative comments, was about the use of AI. We listen to you carefully and are working hard to improve the game to make the gameplay as enjoyable as possible.

In this update, [b]Little Sam’s voice has been replaced with a recording from a real actor[/b]. We hope you’ll enjoy the new version of Little Sam, and that this change will make the gameplay much more enjoyable.

notes.title: Just 3 Days Left! Get Ready for the Prologue Release!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, Car Dealers! 🚗[/h2]
The release of our free prologue is [b]only 3 days[/b] away! If you haven’t added our game to your wishlist yet, now is the perfect time to do so! 😊

In today’s devlog, we want to showcase some key locations on the Winston Springs map that you’ll be able to explore during gameplay.

[h2]1. Car Parts Store 🛠️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/3c863abbd404ef564ae2e5e110cead559b0eca0b.jpg[/img]

This is where you’ll stock up on essential parts for car repairs. The store offers a variety of car parts, cleaning products, and tools for quick fixes. It’s perfect for getting cars back in shape and ready for sale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/b07900cead89f09543a91e696dbfc5d144dcda15.gif[/img]

[h2]2. Gas Station ⛽[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/a3cb6e4ac7946f3556ebd9c8e6a1014db011675a.jpg[/img]

Vehicles in Car Dealer Simulator need fuel to get moving! This is where you’ll fill up your cars. In the future, the gas station will also function as a shop, where you’ll be able to buy various items that can be incredibly helpful during negotiations with stubborn customers. Additionally, you’ll find small car repair parts here that you’ll always want to have on hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/a2efcea390ba0c2f35b4be7aca88a679c36c6058.gif[/img]

[h2]3. Your Company Headquarters 🏢[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/771c4862e64372b56e44fe83113679aeb25f691b.jpg[/img]

This is the heart of your business. Here, you’ll find everything you need to manage your operations: a workshop, car wash, sales lot, office, and a place to relax. As you progress in the game, your headquarters will grow – each wing will offer new opportunities and unique upgrades. The evolving infrastructure will influence how you manage cars and customers, and will help you build your automotive empire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138655/0a03162776137fd2698f74378856b0da3ffb94e4.gif[/img]

These are just a few of the many exciting locations waiting for you in the game. If you’re ready for an adventure in the world of car dealerships, make sure to add our prologue to your wishlist now!
See you in Winston Springs! 🚙💨
